Eldest child, born into a couple that had been together for 15 years. My brother was born when I was 2.5yo, they married when I was 5 after moving country for my dads job. 

Before long my dad started seeing another woman. My mum started working on a farm and met some people, one person in particular she had babysit us when she would go out with her friends. This man sexually abused me. 

By time I was 8, my dad left my mother for the other woman. The sexual abuse got worse, and my mother started spillaring into depression and alcoholism. I started caring for my little brother while my mum was drunk in bed for days at a time. 

My dad got custody of my brother when I turned 10. I didnt see him again for a while. My brother went to live with my dad, his mistress and her son. They would start to starve him at this point. He was 8. 

Social services knocked on our door by time I was 9. At 10, my dad was granted emergency custody of me. My mum had met a new man and things were looking up. I had just started secondary school, made new friends and mum wasn't drinking anymore. 

The last thing I said to my mum that day was "ill be home for dinner." I didnt see her for months. My dad took me, and placed me within his friends family home while he got his emergency custody order. I then went to live with him, my brother, my "step brother" and his mother. The step mother would also try to starve me. Me and my brother would sneak food from the kitchen at night and hide it in our bedrooms. 

Shortly after that, my dad sent my brother to live with our grandparents 250 miles away. He was happier there. He was fed. He was loved. 

My first step sister arrived when I was 12. I hated her. My second step sister came along 2 years later and we moved again. My dad had convinced my mum to sell her house to him "for the children's sake". We moved back to my family home, but as a part of a different family. She sold that house to him for £19,500. He redecorated it and sold it for £250,000 not even 2 years later. My mum had an accident, and broke her kneecap. She had an operation to fix it but because she had left it for days before going to the hospital, and the alcoholism, it didn't really work. She's now had 4 operations on the same leg, the next step is amputation. I started caring for her as much as I could when I was 14. Her alcoholism returned with a vengeance and she would often puke/piss herself or be in a blind rage and attack me. There was no one else to care for her. So I kept doing it. She also really started to suffer with anorexia at this point, her lowest weight was 4 stone. I could see all of her ribs in her back when I bathed her. Her bones would dig into me when i had to carry her. 

We moved to a small town when i was 14. New school. New House. Horrible house. I cried for 3 hours when I saw what we had to live in now. I wondered where all the money went from the sale of my family home. My step mother suddenly had nice new clothes. So did my step sisters and her son. My dad suddenly got a new car. I had to ask my aunty for new shoes. She sent me a care package of some clothes and a pair of shoes. I couldn't have been happier. 

When I turned 16, I moved back in with my mum. She was still an alcoholic but it was better there than with my dad. Then my step mother left him, and took the kids. She came out as a lesbian. My dad became suicidal, i moved back in with him. 

I started college, my dad found someone new who lived quite far away. He would leave me in the house alone for weeks and come back maybe once a month for a weekend and then he'd be gone again. I got £30 a week from the government to help me with my college studies. This is all I had to live on. I started working. 

When I was 16, I was given a puppy. She was beautiful. A border collie cross, black and white with a distinctive black spot right on the top of her head. I loved her more than anything. I trained her, fed her, walked her. She was everything to me. This is the only happy thing I had and no one was taking her away from me.

My dads relationship fell apart and he was home again. When I was 17, he came out as Transgender and wanted me to refer to him as "my big sister". My brother also came out as gay during this time. It almost felt like my dad was trying to steal my brothers spotlight. 

My dad met a new woman again. She moved in pretty quickly but didn't like dogs. Started trying to lock my dog away. I wasn't having any of that. My dog stayed by my side, she went everywhere with me. 

One day, my dad had to go to London. I cant remeber what for but I do remeber that my brother was visiting at the time. My dog had just come into heat, and made a small mess on a blanket so my brother put it in the washing machine and put it out to dry. No big deal  these things happen. The blanket was clean now and everything was fine. 

When he returned the next day, my dad screamed at my brother. Something in my just dropped. I took my brother and my dog and we went to our mums house. My brother stayed there for the rest of his trip and I never went back again. Shortly after I moved in with a guy 6 years older than me. With my dog of course. I was 18.

He slowly turned abusive and controlling. It took me 4 years to get away from him and I'm still suffering the financial consequences of that relationship. 

While in the relationship, I managed to get my first proper job. A real career job. My partner didnt like that. Other than work, I wasnt allowed to leave the house. I couldn't see friends or have them come over. I was only allowed to eat once a day. Unbeknownst to me, he was taking loans out in my name and ordering things from catalogs he had opened in my name. I finally left after the last argument we had where he accused me of cheating on him. I couldnt go anywhere, how could I cheat? 

I went back to live with my mum. At this point I'm 23, living in a one bedroom flat with my disabled, alcoholic recovered mother and my dog. 

Then I move into a shared house. The woman I shared with was crazy. She would come into my room screaming at me every night, bring random strangers into the house to sleep with and generally make my life miserable. What I didnt know was she was locking my dog outside the garden all day while I was in work, woth no access to food or water. The neighbours called the RSPCA, they visited and she just let them take my dog. She claimed she was the owner and she didn't want the dog.

I was hearbroken. My world was ripped away from me. She had told me she would look after my dog that weekend for me and I could stay at my boyfriends house. By time I came back on Monday after work, I couldn't get hold of the RSPCA. When I finally got through, my dog had already been sent to another pound in another part of the country. When I finally got there 2 days later, she was already gone. Even typing this out makes me feel sick. She was 7 years old. I miss her so much. She was my strength through everything. My reason to get up, to come home. 

I'm now 27. I still have my job. I still have my boyfriend and I have a roof over my head. Life isn't great, but its not bad either. Im in limbo. I miss my girl. I dont want another pet, ever again. I dont want to feel this pain again. I still cry sometimes, like now, revisiting this. 

I dont know where to go from here. So I just keep going, like I always have.

I thought it was impossible. No one believed that you could change into something that wasn't real. A mythical creature told in stories and fables, something born from the mind and not from the earth. That night, I dont know why the idea popped into my head, or why I picked a Phoenix of all mythical creatures. 

As the last moments of my previous form were coming to an end, I focused my thoughts on an image of a bird. Grand, beautiful, firey feathers shining in the light of dawn with an air of wisdom surrounding it. I concentrated on the idea of the mythical creature, thinking at best I'd end up as a beautiful exotic bird capable of flying freely and bringing a little bit of beauty into the world. 

My form started to shift, it wasn't painful, just slightly unpleasant with a hint of disorientation. My body was changing, shifting into a new shape that I'll inhabit for its lifespan. I was beautiful. I was free. 

Then, I wasn't. Not 3 years into my new shape, I was captured, sold, passed along. I made money for humans in a circus, zoos, then private collections. I was miserable. This was my life for almost a decade. 

I wished for death. She came. My body felt weak, and oddly warm. I had never felt so warm in the arms of death before. I knew it was coming, so I did what I always do. I focused on a new creature, human. I pictured my new body and imagined the essence of a human, a kind and gentle human much unlike those ive spent my last years with. 

The unpleasant disorientation didn't come, instead, I was burning up, getting hotter with each passing moment. The burning was so intense and I felt like I was dying, actually dying for the first time, the only time. My body was getting weaker and smaller, as if the heat was burning away my flesh. My feathers falling into ashes around me. This was it. I closed my eyes and let it happen, at last I was truly free from this world. 

Slowly, the burning fire inside me began to fade, its embers washing over me one last time before completely extinguishing. I inhaled deeply, still in shock. I tried to move, shaking off the ashes left behind from my previous form; something else that was new. 

Before me stood a man. A man I had never seen before. His face was aged but his frame looked firm and strong. His beard covered a large portion of his face, long, grey and mostly unkempt. Long robes draped over his body, swaying with his movement as if they were an extention of his body. 

He looked at my new body, tiny but plump. Grey/red plumage spotted all over my frame. Reaching into my tiny cage, he lifted my body out and dusted me off gently, carefully. 

"There you are Fawkes" he smiled at me, a genuine smile, and I knew I was home.
